title: Optimize and report through pdfxi optimize
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-cli passes; pdfxi optimize writes a standalone optimized file that reopens with identical page text, reports deterministic counters, removes metadata on request and refuses to overwrite its input; EDIT-014 moves to verified.
notes: CLI host for Document::optimize: --out required and self-overwrite refused, --remove-metadata/--remove-optional/--no-compress flags, signed size change, object/stream/removal counters, warnings, and stable JSON.
